Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Monsoon season is coming. Stock a rainy-day pantry with seven local staples. 🌧️ In Episode 8 of our Uncle Lim family story, the first big rain of October arrives and Jun offers to cook dinner, with four packets of instant noodles and an almost empty kitchen cupboard. A quick run to the supermarket at KSL City Mall, one good question from our nutritionist, and the family sits down to ginger porridge with ikan bilis and egg, turmeric tempeh and garlic kangkung. Seven staples that keep well for rainy evenings in Johor Bahru: dried ikan bilis (rinse it first), eggs, tempeh, oats or brown rice, fresh ginger, turmeric root and garlic. Add a leafy green every few days. Want help planning family meals around your routine? Ask about Dietitian and Nutrition Counselling at Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall, or walk in for a Minute Consult with our pharmacist. Ground Floor, Lot G-001, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. Open every day, 10AM to 10PM.
